newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia T-bills, bonds market value 293 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia T-bills, bonds market value 293 trln rbls.

text.p: The market price of circulating government discount treasury bills and interest bearing bonds rose on Friday to 292.71 trillion roubles ($50.6 billion) from 287.43 trillion on June 13, the Central Bank said on Monday.

The market price of circulating GKO T-bills fell to 240.37 trillion roubles from 242.02 trillion roubles a week earlier, while the market price of government bonds rose to 52.36 trillion roubles from 45.41 trillion roubles.
The current nominal value of T-bills and bonds rose on Friday to 309.30 trillion roubles from 302.04 trillion roubles.
Portfolio duration, the average maturity of the securities, weighted according to volume in circulation, increased to 207.8 days from 185.5 days on June 13.
